title: EGR Tool for Ford 6.7L Diesel Engines
lead: MOC has developed a new tool to clean the Ford 6.7L Diesel EGR valves and coolers. This tool is designed to be used when performing services with our Optimizer™ Foaming Combustion Chamber & Emission System Cleaner, and is easy to install. User instructions are included with each tool.
body: The MOC Optimizer™ product (Part # 16501) is sold separately. The image below shows the new tool that is now available for purchase.
